name: PingFederate LAB
description: One shelf with a card for each PingFederate feature behind AI agents: pi.flow sign-in, DCR, RAR with PAR (and DPoP), CIBA, DPoP, token exchange, Userinfo, PAR, PKCE and a protocol playground. Runs on a built-in mock PingFederate (offline) or your own PingFederate (live).
notes: Host-run: npm install && npm run build && npm start (port 5400, loopback only; mock mode needs no settings, and mock sign-in is on while no PingFederate is saved). Docker: docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:5400 only; HOST_PORT=<5400-5449> moves it). Catalog A28.
